intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia hold talks in Abu Dhabi
items.text: New talks between Russia and Ukraine begin on Tuesday in Abu Dhabi. The United States has arranged the meeting, and Vladimir Medinsky and Rustem Umerov lead the two delegations. The Kremlin has said that European countries will not take part. Overnight air strikes killed one person and injured seven. President Zelenskyy has said that the EU will use an emergency mechanism to fund Ukraine.

gloss.delegation: a group of people who represent a country at a meeting
gloss.take part: to join an activity or event
gloss.emergency mechanism: a special system used when a situation is urgent

items.title: France accuses Iran of hacking food sites
items.text: France has accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of hacking the refrigeration systems of nearly 700 food sites in October. The attacks caused at least 15 fires, according to the French government. Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot called the incident unprecedented. Paris has said it rules nothing out in response. Iran has not yet replied to the accusation.

gloss.accuse: to say that someone has done something wrong
gloss.hack: to get into a computer system without permission
gloss.rule out: to decide that something is not possible
gloss.refrigeration: the process of keeping food cold

items.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 and a half years
items.text: Comedian Russell Brand has been sentenced to ten and a half years in prison for rape and sexual assault. The sentence followed his conviction. The case has led to difficult questions about the British entertainment industry. CNN reported on the reaction to the verdict over the weekend. Brand had been granted bail earlier in the legal process.

gloss.sentence: to officially decide a punishment for a crime
gloss.conviction: a decision in court that someone is guilty
gloss.verdict: the official decision of a court
gloss.bail: permission to stay free until a trial, often after paying money

items.title: Man Utd expected to change manager
items.text: Manchester United are expected to change manager before their trip to Anfield in 13 days, according to a report by The Athletic. United are 18th after a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on Sunday. Michael Carrick has won one league game and drawn five in ten. The club says that no final decision has been made. Mauricio Pochettino, Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann have been named as possible replacements.

gloss.draw: a game in which both teams score the same number of goals
gloss.relegation zone: the lowest places in a league, where teams may move to a lower division
gloss.replacement: a person who takes over from someone else
gloss.according to: as said by a particular source

items.title: Jodar completes ATP Finals field
items.text: The eight players for the ATP Finals in Turin are now set. Alexander Zverev leads the season Race with 9,350 points. Rafael Jodar was the last to qualify with 3,234 points, 64 more than reserve Alex de Minaur. Jannik Sinner has 7,950 points but misses the event because of injury. Carlos Alcaraz is on 5,500 points.

gloss.qualify: to reach the standard needed to take part
gloss.reserve: a player who is ready to replace another
gloss.miss: to be absent from an event
gloss.field: all the players in a competition

items.title: Nvidia opens probe into chief executive
items.text: Nvidia's board has opened an independent investigation after reports that chief executive Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. The company's shares fell sharply on the news. Mr Huang has apologised for the relationship, and Nvidia says he will remain in his job. China has called the allegations nothing but smears. A shareholder lawsuit has also been filed.

gloss.board: the group of people who manage a company
gloss.shares: parts of a company that people can buy and sell
gloss.lawsuit: a case brought to a court by a person or group
gloss.smear: a false claim made to damage someone's reputation

items.title: Fossil fuel emissions set to fall in 2026
items.text: Global carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels are expected to fall by 0.4 per cent in 2026, to 38.2 billion tonnes. The Global Carbon Budget report says this would be the first yearly fall since 2020. Researchers link the drop to the war involving Iran, which pushed oil prices up and cut oil use. The growth of renewable energy has also helped. Scientists warn that the fall may not last.

gloss.emissions: gases sent into the air, for example from cars and factories
gloss.fossil fuel: a fuel such as coal, oil or gas made from ancient plants and animals
gloss.renewable energy: power from sources that do not run out, such as wind and sun
gloss.budget: a plan for how much of something can be used
gloss.link: to say that two things are connected

items.title: M John Harrison wins the Booker Prize
items.text: British author M John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize with his novel The End of Everything. At 81, he is the oldest person ever to win the award. The prize is worth 50,000 pounds. The prize was announced on Monday. Harrison is 81 years old, which makes him the oldest winner in the history of the prize.

items.title: Take-Two raises hopes before GTA VI launch
items.text: Take-Two Interactive has said that pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI are far above its first expectations. Chief executive Strauss Zelnick said on a call with investors that Rockstar has finished development of the game. The company expects net bookings of 8.0 to 8.2 billion dollars this financial year. Net bookings in the second quarter were 1.60 billion dollars. No pre-order figure was given.

gloss.pre-order: to pay for a product before it is on sale
gloss.net bookings: a measure of the value of sales in a period
gloss.investor: a person who puts money into a company
gloss.financial year: a twelve-month period used by a company for its accounts

items.title: Rockstar plans a GTA VI festival in Miami
items.text: Rockstar and PlayStation will hold Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami on 21 November, two days after the game launches. The event takes place at Mana Wynwood and has two stages. Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin and Justice are among the named acts. Winners of a giveaway aged 17 or over can get tickets. Pre-loading of the game began on Tuesday and needs up to 212 GB of space.

gloss.launch: to put a new product on sale
gloss.giveaway: a prize draw where people can win free items
gloss.stage: a raised area where performers stand
gloss.pre-load: to download a game before its release date
